title: Review: São Paulo, Rio and Brazilian culture
goal: Review São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, the Modern Art Week, Brazilian music and the neighbour languages, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: reformulation markers, relative clauses, se, stance adverbs, cuanto más ..., más ...

items: I can review what I learned about São Paulo, Rio and Brazilian culture.
I can restate an idea, add a relative clause and tell the jobs of *se*.
I can use stance adverbs and *cuanto más ..., más ...* about Brazil.
I can restate an idea about Brazil with *es decir*, *o sea* or *en otras palabras*.
I can describe places in Rio with relative clauses such as *que*, *donde* and *cuyo* (review).
I can tell the different jobs of *se* in a text about the Modern Art Week of 1922 (review).
I can add my view of a fact about Brazilian music with adverbs such as *en realidad* and *precisamente* (review).
I can link two changes about learning Portuguese with *cuanto más ..., más ...* and *a medida que* (review).
sections.title: Can you do this?
